hypothesis: A span-dependent variance shape supported by public train count covariance may improve weighted OD inference, but observable likelihood cannot rule out harmful nullspace extrapolation. Stress all fixed strengths under matched-shape and wrong-noise cases.
algorithm: Nonnegative weighted ridge, objective0.5||Af-c||2+0.5*0.05*sum((f-b)^2/w). w=(1-alpha)+alpha*w_span, w_span trace-normalized relative to uniform under original independent QR equations.
noise: Additive scales0.5/2 from uniform covariance fit; logsigma0.35/0.8, origin/destination0.25/0.6, positive lognormal background0.5/2 times truth mean. Span noise uses calibrated w_span then clips supplied b positive; clipping is explicit misspecification, not an exact posterior-model control.
selection: All four strengths retained, no selection on these artificial scores. Same public networks but new synthetic seed, not whole-system blind data or hidden OD validation.
scope: No actual Task4 candidate exported, official frozen reference unchanged and no Kaggle upload.
